notes.title: BattleGroupVR2 Announcement - A New Frontier Awaits 🚀
notes.content:
Greetings commanders!

It’s been an incredible journey since launching BattleGroupVR, and I can’t thank you enough for all the support!

I’ve been working on a sequel these past few years that expands on everything that made BattleGroupVR fun while adding a robust framework for new features and ways to play. The STEAM page has just been made public here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3385960/BattleGroupVR2/
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145337/2fa34b7dd5950b8cd9cf86e1e2cf9d465162a04a.jpg

Here’s what’s in store:
🔧 Rebuilt Game – I remade the entire game from the ground up so the code base is properly put together and with the scope of what BGVR1 did and more. The battle system has been reworked to fully incorporate full 3D space with 6 shield arcs instead of the flat 4.

🚀 Open-World Mode – Ever wanted to roam the galaxy freely? Now you can! Take on missions, mine resources, trade, hunt pirates, and grow your fleet however you want. No set path—just you, your ships, and a the galaxy to bring to heel.

🔥 Gauntlet Mode – A combat focused, high-risk, high-reward mode where you’ll fight through a procedurally generated map, taking on missions in each sector. Go as far as you can for bigger rewards, but bigger challenges.

⚔️ Conquest Mode – The fan favorite mode is coming back! Create your own factions and battle it out over a persistent map where you compete with other players for control of the galaxy. Your fleet will fight when you’re offline. Expand, fortify, and prove yourself as the best commander out there!

Of course, there’s also deep fleet customization, tons of ships to unlock, and real-time tactical combat designed for epic space battles.

This is still a solo project, just like BattleGroupVR, but I’m building something bigger and better thanks to everything I’ve learned—and all the feedback you’ve given me. I’ll be sharing more details soon. If you haven't already, I’d love to hear your thoughts in the Discord!
💬 https://discord.gg/f86JjH9Nqe


👉 Wishlist on Steam Now! 👈
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3385960/BattleGroupVR2/
If you could do me the honor of WISHLISTING it, that would be greatly appreciated!

As always — see you on the bridge!

– Commander Ken

notes.title: Upcoming Plans and Status
notes.content:
BattleGroup VR has been in development last 7 years. Initially, it was supposed to be a single-player game, but then the modding, multiplayer, and conquest modes were added. There will be one last update with localization and subtitles and the game will enter 1.0 — the Final Frontier.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145337/7f3010153fa935fac871d8755f7f4107d1a97b9d.png

Thank you for your support, and valuable feedback through this process. It would not be the same without your support. Developing BattleGroupVR my first commercial game. While I had previous hobbyist experience coding for fun. This was the first time anyone other than myself could enjoy it with me. That being said - I had no idea what I was doing.

Unfortunately, the codebase is not how I would build it today. Due to my lack of experience when I started almost a decade ago, the game is very difficult to maintain and expand on. For one, I basically made all the missions by hand with no reusable system to run them on — it's just one big script per mission. Terrible design choice, but I didn't know any better at the time. In addition, the scope of the project expanded beyond the single-player experience, and other features were sort of tacked on as the vision arose so it's a pile of spaghetti code entangled within itself.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145337/5fc5bbdce89f0707be9ea874e35b486da9e77b64.png

It is much harder to rewrite/refactor everything vs starting fresh from scratch. Therefore, I made a decision to wrap things up with BattleGroupVR and will finally release it in Version 1.0 in a couple of months. The game has been feature complete and stable for a long time now. I could then start on a new project, now I have the experience to improve it.

I am currently working on Star Survivor (it's vampire survivor in space) — it is a good quick project to practice what I've learned from BattleGroupVR. You could check it out in SpaceOwl bundle to get 10% off both.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/32094/SpaceOwl_Games/

If you have been on the fence because of the EA status, I can assure you it is in its final form just awaiting a relabel. The next discount for 20% off we be available between May 9-16. Please give it a try!

BattleGroupVR2?
I intend to revisit this after a few other projects. I want to expand on this idea and incorporate more open-world elements found in other space games. I envision an open sector map where you are a mercenary fleet (as you are now) but instead of a linear single-player campaign, you can travel around and pick up missions from various quest givers (hopefully with a modular mission system so players can create missions to populate the world with). Fly around mine asteroids, trade goods along dangerous routes for profit, get attacked by pirates... hunt them, explore - all the hallmarks of scifi games like Elite Dangerous except all from the bridge of your flagship in VR.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145337/f299fe4f9d72544a202ca4a80b1248c871acb88a.png

I hope to see some of you in the future when I have something to show as I will need captains to test :)

- Commander Ken

Not sure what causes this so I implemented a catch where the ship will reposition itself to its last valid location. Hopefully, this will bypass and correct any one-off random accidents... or worst case it will put the ship back into a position where it will immediately go NaN again, please let me know if you see more ships disappearing after this patch.

I have not been able to replicate this on my end making it impossible for me to fix it. I have created a tool that will print out all the ship status to help narrow what might be going on when players encounter it. So, if you run into this issue, there is a new button at the rear of the bridge below the Emergency Exit button to print out a report. This will log the game state and open a File Explorer to the generated text file called "shipreport.txt". Please send this file to me over Discord or email to battlegroupvr@gmail.com

notes.title: Multiplayer Campaign Co-op
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145337/5a44a6f1bcb1fee85cb5a73c93940c047f2ff3d6.png

Hello Captains and Commanders,
It has been a while since the last update. Sorry for the radio silence, I have been busy with personal events but have not stopped working on the latest update. This one took a lot more work than anticipated as it required refactoring of the entire single-player campaign to support multiplayer.

Story Mode Campaign Coop
This new 2-player cooperative mode can be found in the main menu in Play. It is the entire single-player story campaign but now you can enjoy it with another first officer. You will have the option to host or join a game, no settings required and it is always password protected. You will then have the option to create a new co-op fleet or use a previous one. The host will be in charge of selecting missions, starting mission briefings, and initiating warp-outs during the campaign. Each player will be in charge of his or her own fleet and the game will respond to both as if they were one, which means enemy fleets will be scaled to match the sum total of you and your ally's combined forces.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145337/36c90a4a2de35ac8fd9047d437b93171ae75b150.jpg

Other Notes:
Multiplayer has been down the past few weeks because of an update Google had made to their STUN servers which affected the multiplayer framework I use (Photon Bolt) so there was an extra delay in getting that updated and fixed as it was all related to this patch it had to come packed with this update. Sorry for the delay on that.

I hope you all enjoy and please let me know if you run into any issues over on the discord as this is a brand new feature that required a lot of internal refactoring, I expect to have missed lots of stuff.

Discord Link: https://discord.gg/4aCZ56W

Apologies again for the long-overdue update. Development slowed significantly during this build since working with multiplayer networks sucks and everything takes 3x as long to sync and test, it really killed the mood. But now that's finished, I am happy to get back to regular bug fixes and updates.

- New endless challenge mode open for testing:
Face endless waves of enemies and push your fleet composition to its limit for the top score.
Create your perfect fleet from the ships and equipment you have unlocked and enter battle. Waves of increasing difficulties will try to destroy you. Fight to the end for final scoring. End scoring will occur when your flagship is destroyed. The score is calculated based on the cost of ships you destroy divided by the value of the fleet you brought in. - "Act As One" battlegroup formation setting now applies to move commands, will route the command to the group leader instead of breaking off. So this setting effectively locks the ships together in this formation mode.
- Targeted location-based abilities (flak, tact warp) now also work with "Act As One" formation setting with offset to target position based on group position. Multiplayer Overhaul
Hello everyone! Been working on fleshing out the multiplayer features in addition to making the online gameplay more stable and accurate. Networking is a new frontier for me so I am still a noob at how this all works so work on this has been painfully slow.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145337/2e4ede7976b8801cc21cf3f75692e56cf6ad5563.jpg
Here are the new features:

- Option to add AI controlled fleets
- Option to select fleet for AI to control

Note: Dreads still not working in multiplayer.

New Weapon: Autogun
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145337/f1bbdfda47e2a80d1b45f3db44140d5835c2ab39.jpg
This has been secretly available for a few weeks now so you may already have seen it. The Autogun is a new light turret that resembles a Gatlin gun. Technically, it behaves like a laser that does not have damage drop off and has bonus damage to hull. Was there a big need for this? Probably not, but I just like how it looks and sounds.

Other Changes:
- Added display information about captain passive skill increase per level
- Reduced bridge shake for large cannons
- Recalling strike craft now responds with appropriate voice line
- Captain management now accessible at Repair Station in campaign
- Added "delete" option to multiplayer fleets

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed certain non-combat ships in the campaign not warping out when fleeing
- Fixed multiplayer games not triggering mission accomplished
- Voice commands now validates if the target is friendly before engaging

What's Next?
- Mission Tutorial: The current tutorial is meh, it gives you all the information you need but not very polished or engaging. I want to create a specific mission that throws you into the hot seat and shows you what you need to know to quickly get started. I will keep the current tutorial as a more in-depth instructional.

- Online Campaign Coop: With the groundwork laid in this multiplayer update (multi teams, networked AI fleets) this opens the door for online campaign coop where two players can play the campaign in sync and each brings in their individual fleets to the same mission. With the auto-scaling AI, it should adapt accordingly to still be challenging with two fleets.

notes.title: January Update Summary
notes.content:
Jan 2021 - Update Summary
Hope everyone's new year is starting off well! I've made a bunch of little changes via several mini patches since the end of December. Here's the full list of updates from 12/27/2020 to 1/21/2021.

Changes / New Features
- changed weapon arc indicators on the map view to change color depending on if the weapon is out of range (grey), firing (yellow), or flash red if min range
- added a new capital weapon to the battleship (it didn't have a special before), called the Burst Cannon, which will fire a volley of high damage projectiles at ALL targets 90 degrees left and right of the battleship.
- fixed conquest report warp lane upgrade always level 1
- right-hand menu Clear View now works on all bridge sizes
- changed warp out a method to attempt to fix objects intersecting with the bridge (unverified) 
- shipyard ship descriptions now show slot details on tooltip hover
- ship roster now shows equipped components on tooltip hover
- conquest fleets now revert to their previous location if leave/defeat during the battle
- adjusted heavy transport resupply component to not overlap with other modules

Save File Backup System
I added a backup save feature that will save your fleet data at the beginning and end of your session to /backups in your game save directory. Save will be performed on start game and game exit, they can be found here: C:\Users\yourname\AppData\LocalLow\SpaceOwl Games\BattleGroupVR\backups
Files that start with "gsd-XXXX" are fleet/campaign files, ppd.gd is the player unlock progress.

You can restore them by copying to the root folder (C:\Users\yourname\AppData\LocalLow\SpaceOwl Games\BattleGroupVR) and removing the timestamp after the dash, so your backup file will be like gsd1234.gd and your backup will be gsd1234-4398523453.gd, so just remove the "-4398523453" in the file name / override your old save and your restored.

Bug Fixes
- fixed buying issues for conquest and MP when no campaign has been started
- fixed selling ships in Multiplayer issue
- fixed upgrade chip not being able to be picked up in the tutorial
- fixed conquest name + portrait change do not save
- fixed loophole where flagship can be set to docked ship
- fixed issue with multiplayer fleets not recalculated consistently
- fixed issue with selling unlimited components
- fixed issue with copy leader not sending a command to all units
- fixed helm speed bar stuck at 100%
- fixed component description display issues not updating
- fixed conquest new accounts stuck in select faction menu

- fixed conquest defense platforms preventing mission completion
- fixed bug where your roster captains would not show if you had no ships

Other news:
Voice Commands - been trying to rebuild the voice command system using Google Voice Recognition and while I have it working, it is very inaccurate because it does not use a strict grammar structure like Windows Native Voice Recognition. It's also a lot slower since it has to send the audio to a remote google server for processing before returning the text result. I will need to do more research on this to find something that better fits the bill.

Hope everyone is staying safe and having a good holiday all things considered! I signed up for the Steam Winter Sale (Dec 22 - Jan 5) so BattleGroupVR will be on sale for 30% off, if you have any friends that were thinking of getting it please let them know and try out multiplayer!

Thanks again for all your support and I hope you have a wonderful rest of the year!

notes.title: BattleGroupVR Multiplayer Alpha
notes.content:
Multiplayer Alpha Test Now Public

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145337/1493712b48541008c7511aa61b26622c11399295.png

Been working on networking for the past few weeks. I believe it is finally ready for public testing and I'm excited to have everyone try it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145337/e380bb435658f2743523070362bd19c92d814430.jpg

New Multiplayer Menu
 A new menu button has been added to the lobby main menu for Multiplayer. This will open the multiplayer menu that will list available games in the center, host game options on the left, and multiplayer fleets on the right.

You can create fleets specifically for multiplayer before a match or during the lobby of a joined game. Each fleet will be weighed based on the resources spent on it.

Hosting A Game
When hosting a game, the creator will need to choose if they wish to limit the fleet sizes each player can field. The options are: Unlimited, Armada (1000000), Fleet (500000), Large (250000), Medium (100000), Small (50000) - These are subject to change. Other options will be available at a later update. All games are hosted from the hosters machine, so if they disconnect, so will everyone else. Just like the good old days of multiplayer.

Multiplayer Lobby
Once a game is created it will be publically listed in the main list for others to see. No private games yet, that will be added next. Once joined you will enter the multiplayer lobby to set up your fleet:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145337/088198d90efb1f81a1b56a9f4ac4c05299435c32.jpg

Currently max 4 player slots. Please note this has only been tested 1v1 so there will probably be bugs with more than two players.

Multiplayer Fleet Creation
The fleet creation interface is the same as the campaign except all purchases are tallied against the total. There is no resource gain or persistence in multiplayer. All equipment that has been unlocked in the campaign will be available in multiplayer. When a player is ready, on the right-hand menu will be the "Ready" button. Selecting this will highlight the player's area green for go.

Starting The Match
Once all players are readied, the game will automatically countdown to start. After the host machine creates the game, all other players will connect and drop out of warp on the sides of the map. There is currently only one mode: pvp free for all currently, other modes will be added later.

https://thumbs.gfycat.com/AgileGivingFox-size_restricted.gif

Things that are currently networked:
- Ship position and orientation
- Ship health and shield stats, current subsystem priorities and targeting
- Weapon fire events for lasers, cannons and missiles
- Special ability events for active abilities (self-cast, targeted, and area)
- Fighter squadron spawns

Things To Come
Things that are planned but not implemented yet:
- private/password games
- in-game astroids
- team settings for 2v2, 3v1, etc
- AI opponents
- different scenarios like defend or escort
- co-op multiplayer campaign drop-in feature

Hope you enjoy, please report any bugs you run across in the discord: https://discord.gg/4aCZ56W
This is fresh out of the oven so you should expect bugs.

notes.title: New Conquest Mode Details
notes.content:
New Conquest Mode Live!
Been working on the new Conquest Mode these past few weeks. It became public last week in an "alpha" stage to put it through its paces. Here's a video going through all the features:
[previewyoutube=L7MJHVN5itA;full][/previewyoutube]

What is Conquest?
Conquest mode is an asymmetrical offline multiplayer mode where players create a profile belonging to one of three factions and battle it out for territory on a shared world map.

Create A Profile
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145337/ed28b48a7663e6f9979a4a9d42c96f2b884fd002.jpg
Profile Creation:
- Choose your commander name
- Choose your profile picture
- Select your faction between Imperial, Uprising, and Raider
No difference between the factions at the moment, this may change in the future.

You will spawn at your home system where you start by configuring your ship like you would for the standard campaign. Once your ship is geared out and captain assigned you can join the map.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145337/c269cdf45203de19826897803f013f434dac97e2.jpg
The map is made of 200 sectors which can be claimed and battled over. Travel radius is defined by the circle around your current location, this is influenced by the Warpgate level on a sector.

Sectors are color-coded to:
- blue: sectors you own
- green: sectors your faction owns
- red: enemy faction
- white: unclaimed sectors

The Conquest Map
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145337/797df7d6717a40924e7338ad9da8ff2144e0f69b.jpg
You can see important structures surrounding each planet: Shipyard, warp gate, and defense platform. These can be built by the sector owner.

Sector Buildings
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145337/a56f7cedd902b9893488d14b63c0a4b3c642ac6d.jpg
Total list of buildings:
- Shipyard: A way station for purchase of repairs and resupply at this sector, the higher the shipyard level, the cheaper the repairs/supplies.
- Warp Gate: Increases the jump range from this sector.
- Defense platform: Creates a weapons platform, defense outpost, or battle station depending on level to help in the defense of the sector if challenged.
- Refinery: Increases the credit production of this sector for the owner every 24 hrs.
- Research Station: Increases the upgrade point production for the owner every 24 hrs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145337/c269cdf45203de19826897803f013f434dac97e2.jpg
Selecting a sector will give you several pieces of information and options:

The sector profile board will show you the sector name (you can rename it if you control it), the system level, how far it is developed till the next level, and the unrest level. Below is the list of structures and the generated income.

Enemy Options:
- engage the sector if not of your faction to try to gain control of it. This will start a battle where any enemy faction fleets that are present will defend (defended), or the local garrison will match your forces in defense if no player fleets are present (undefended)

Friendly Options:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145337/155fb9e5c417a8118c0628e720374ab580d7df3c.jpg
You can assist a friendly sector for a reward in three ways:

- Delivery development: This is an escort mission that will increase that sectors development, once enough have been completed, the sector will rise in level which increases the number of buildings it can have.
- Crush Unrest: Unrest will increase for each owned but undefended sector, once unrest reaches its limit, the sector will revert back to neutral. Completing this mission will reset the unrest level back to zero.
- Enforce warp lane: increases the connectivity between two sectors, warping along this path will reduce supply costs by 15% per warp lane level. Lanes will be represented by lines from the current system.

You can also simply warp to the system to move your fleet. Warping between sectors will cost fleet supply, the amount is determined by the size of the fleet, the distance, and the warp lane level.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145337/066c7432080cc4eb9b536974bd1fb699a1dd5c45.jpg
Overtime warp routes should develop as people enforce them. Alternatively, you can also lower a warp lane by Raiding, this option will appear on a developed warp lane between at least one unfriendly sector and your current location. The mission is to destroy a warp beacon, the enemy fleet will then warp in to respond where you will ambush and destroy that fleet to reduce a warp lane by one level.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145337/cdd446ac98a999d9a412d0cec47adc5bdd113d3c.jpg
When attacking a sector, the system's structures will also appear (shipyard, warp gate). If you destroy these buildings, it will also reduce that building level on the sector level.

Ragnarok
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145337/608932cd88aa93f9a53610b02997ee913dc3de30.jpg
There is a planet in the center that is twice as large as any other and is always visible, this will be used as a king of the hill battlezone for showing off your strongest fleets.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145337/61b7628a5b36bf03cb3f62afb8afa0a47592f465.jpg
Your deeds will be broadcast to the rest of the sector on the Activity Panel for all to see and be in awe of your conquest, achievements, and glory.

That the basics of Conquest, hope you get a chance to check it out. I will see you on the map!

notes.title: BattleGroupVR Native Voice Commands
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145337/90fd2bc5b85cf15248e71fbad1b475b5177d22e5.png
Today's update is for a new feature: native voice commands! Using the built-in Windows speech to text dictation, you can now command your fleet without any UI interactions.

[previewyoutube=bEOPp9wzuOI;full][/previewyoutube]

You can say things in the form of [SUBJECT] [COMMAND] [TARGET]

Examples:
"all ships form up on me"
"blue five engage red two"
"turn left"
"blue one fire lancer beam on red five"
"move forward"
"all units all power to weapons"

List of Subjects:

 none (my ship)
 blue 1, blue 2, blue 3, blue (#1-X) for each ally
 my ship
 all units, all ships
 all squadrons, all strike craft
 all fighters
 all bombers


List of Commands:

 engage, attack, target
 form up, form battlegroup, group up
 fall back, retreat
 stop, all stop, hault, hold position
 level off
 reset power, balance power
 target engines/weapons/shields
 all power to engines/weapons/shields, power to engines/weapons/shields, max engines/weapons/shields
 set range close/medium/long, set distance close/medium/long
 flank forward/left/right/back
 move forward/left/right/back
 turn forward/left/right/back
 set bearing 0/45/90/140/180/220/270/315 1-X thousand (meters)
 fire/activate (special ability name: ex: lancer beam/missile barrage/shield hack)
 launch fighter squadrons/fighters/bomber squadrons/bombers
 return to carrier / recover bombers / recover fighters / recover squadrons
 center map, center
 focus
 zoom out
 zoom in


List of Targets:

 none (subject current target)
 red 1, red 2, red 3, red (#1-X) for each target


Full grammar list: https://battlegroupvr.com/files/bgvrGrammar.xml

notes.title: Lazy Captain's Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145337/bc24bbbeb1fdea1a369795c2d76be6b37b3f21fc.jpg

First off I wanted to say: THANK YOU! - This past week has been an amazing experience and I just wanted to thank everyone for their support and feedback. The Early Access has gone very well, with very positive reviews so far. I am so glad that everyone is enjoying the game! It really means a lot!

Updates
Ok, onto the updates! This week was focused on bug fixes and quality of life changes. The major issues were that sometimes the menu's being out of reach or awkwardly high or low or even behind you.

New changes:

 added hover scan to the buttons, so you can now just "mouse over" them to trigger
 this also works with sliders so you can adjust speed/power in helm at a distance
 grip for adjustment menu bars also works with this so just hover over and grip/trigger to move them around
 added z-depth to auto-adjusting menus so they will get closer to you if far away in addition to the height adjustment
 added menu distance safety check where the menu will reset to default if more then 6ft away as they are immune to social distancing
 auto-adjusting menus is now an option in the settings


So now you can all relax and sit down and interact with everything without having to even touch it! It's actually very convenient, especially if you want to play seated and don't want to adjust every menu perfectly. 

Bug Fixes:

 WMR controller bindings fixed
 Cosmo controller bindings fixed
 Mission 8 briefing fixed


Currently Working On:
Custom ship modding to allow an easier and flexible way to create custom ships. Decided on the Unity Asset Bundle method. Also working with Steam Workshops so these can be posted and imported by anyone within the game. Seeing good results so far!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145337/fb37166b2e345d39f6bbde6cde379864751e7184.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145337/43ee30f99a988cd0a82a4593900ae53bbba9ad5a.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145337/971f967e2d70a8e462da9bf734599d39ba07f185.png

If you're interested in the mods, latest news, have some feedback or suggestions, please join us on the discord: https://discord.gg/4aCZ56W

notes.title: Local Co-op Update Backlog
notes.content:
Local Co-op - March 2020
[previewyoutube=LN16QYUTQzA;full][/previewyoutube]
Added local co-op mode to the game where a friend can command a ship from your fleet on your computer while you are in VR. Control scheme based on games like Dreadnought or Fractured Space which is a 3rd person overhead camera with mouse pivot look. Keyboard commands for steering and number line for special abilities. The computer player will have the option to select from any ship in the fleet. The ship will ignore any commands given in VR if it is controlled by the PC player and there is a marking indicating so. Preview footage here: YouTube Video Preview

notes.title: Inventory Update
notes.content: New update with an overhaul of the ship equipment system. We now have an inventory and hardpoint system per ship that will allow full customization of each vessel. New items can be discovered during missions and unlocked and purchased in a new equipment tab within the campaign home base menu.
